title: Ranking
description: Multi-stat tracking plugin with rankings, sign display, and EmeraldBank rewards
body:
# Ranking - Multi-Stat Tracking & Leaderboard

A comprehensive statistics tracking plugin that counts 7 different player activities, displays rankings, and provides emerald rewards through EmeraldBank integration.

## Features

### 7 Statistics Types
- **Mining** - Blocks broken (excluding creative mode)
- **Fishing** - Fish caught
- **Placing** - Blocks placed
- **Eating** - Food consumed
- **Killing** - Mobs killed
- **Level** - Current XP level
- **Damage** - Total damage dealt

### Ranking System
- **Per-Stat Rankings** - View leaderboards for each stat type
- **Sign Display** - Show rankings on signs (single rank or range 1-4)
- **Auto Update** - Signs update automatically (configurable interval)

### Reward System
- **EmeraldBank Integration** - Automatic emerald rewards
- **Per-Stat Configuration** - Set rewards for each stat type individually
- **Customizable Rates** - Configure actions per emerald and reward amount

### Data Management
- **Auto Save** - Periodic saving (default: 5 minutes)
- **Monthly Reset** - Automatic reset on 1st of each month
- **Archive System** - Previous month data saved as text file

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/ranking` | View your stats | `ranking.stats` |
| `/ranking stats [player]` | View player stats | `ranking.stats.others` |
| `/ranking ranking [type] [limit]` | View leaderboard | `ranking.ranking` |
| `/ranking setsign <type> <rank>` | Set ranking sign | `ranking.admin` |
| `/ranking removesign` | Remove sign | `ranking.admin` |
| `/ranking reload` | Reload config | `ranking.admin` |

**Aliases:** /rank, /miningrank, /mrank

## Permissions

| Permission | Default |
|------------|---------|
| `ranking.stats` | true |
| `ranking.stats.others` | op |
| `ranking.ranking` | true |
| `ranking.admin` | op |

## Dependencies

| Plugin | Required |
|--------|----------|
| EmeraldBank | Yes |

## Requirements
- Spigot/Paper 1.21.x
- Java 17+

---

## 日本語 (Japanese)

7種類の統計をカウントしてランキング表示とエメラルド報酬を提供するプラグインです。

**統計タイプ:** 採掘、釣り、設置、食事、討伐、レベル、与ダメージ

**ランキング:** 各統計タイプ別のランキング表示、看板への自動表示対応

**報酬:** EmeraldBank連携で自動エメラルド付与。各統計タイプごとに報酬レートを設定可能。

**データ管理:** 5分ごとの自動保存、毎月1日に自動リセット（前月データはアーカイブに保存）

**Discord:** https://discord.gg/zYY55dzhjd
